mapper.sql: select version_id, dataset_id, version_no, version_name, definition_json, schema_version, revision, version_status, health_status, validation_message, release_note, publish_by, publish_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from dp_dataset_version
mapper.select: select version_id, dataset_id, version_no, version_name, schema_version, revision, version_status, health_status, validation_message, release_note, publish_by, publish_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from dp_dataset_version where dataset_id = #{datasetId} order by version_no desc
select count(1) from dp_dataset_version where dataset_id = #{datasetId} and version_status = 'DRAFT'
select version_id from dp_dataset_version where dataset_id = #{datasetId} and version_status = 'ONLINE' and version_id != #{excludeVersionId} order by version_no desc limit 1

select d.dataset_id as datasetId, v.version_id as versionId, v.version_no as versionNo, v.version_name as versionName, (v.version_id = d.default_version_id) as isDefault from dp_dataset d join dp_dataset_version v on v.dataset_id = d.dataset_id and v.version_status = 'ONLINE' where d.dataset_id = #{datasetId} and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' order by (v.version_id = d.default_version_id) desc, v.version_no desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into dp_dataset_version ( dataset_id, version_no, version_name, definition_json, schema_version, version_status, health_status, validation_message, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{datasetId}, #{versionNo}, #{versionName}, #{definitionJson}, #{schemaVersion}, #{versionStatus}, #{healthStatus}, #{validationMessage}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
